corrections.text: The article quotes CEO Bobby Gallagher as saying the milestone "demonstrates the dedication of our team and moves us one step closer to delivering reliable, resilient, and deployable nuclear energy solutions." Both cited sources (Deployable Energy's PR Newswire release and World Nuclear News) render the quote as "demonstrates the dedication of our team and partners and moves us collectively one step closer to delivering reliable, resilient, and deployable nuclear energy solutions." The words "and partners" and "collectively" were omitted from inside the quotation marks without an ellipsis.
